summary: Vehicle consistently pulls right, requiring constant steering correction even after multiple alignments and service inspections.
Automatic high-beam system intermittently turns headlights on and off without clear warning, leaving the driver unable to know whether lights are active in darkness.
Fuel pump recall repairs caused hard starting, fuel smell, and the vehicle to shut off while backing up and driving.
Rear self-leveling shocks made noise over bumps and failed twice, requiring replacement at low mileage.
Sunroof glass shattered and collapsed inward while driving, with no warning light.
Parking brake light blinked and the vehicle would not move in either forward or reverse.
The steering wheel became hard to turn, the vehicle drifted right, and it crashed into a mailbox, causing injuries and vehicle destruction.
Water leaked into the cab through a cracked rear window seal.
Engine lifters failed on both sides, causing severe shaking, roadside stranding, and ultimately requiring a full engine replacement.
The vehicle would not shift properly into reverse or drive and later lost power, with warning lights on and a brake switch fault diagnosed.
Windshield suddenly cracked while driving and the crack spread into the driver’s field of vision.
The engine has excessive oil consumption, misfiring, and recurring P0020 faults, and it still does not run properly after a catalytic converter replacement.
The rear brake light assembly detached from the vehicle while driving, forcing the driver to pull over.
PTU failed, making clicking noises and smoking, then ignited oil under the vehicle and damaged the driveshaft and rear differential.
The air bag warning light stayed on, and the recall repair part was unavailable for a long time.
Fuel injectors and seals repeatedly failed, causing shaking, loss of power, and fuel leaks with strong fumes from raw fuel on the engine.
The engine shut off, then made loud cranking and rattling noises and was diagnosed with lifter-related engine failure needing rebuild or replacement.
Transmission rattles and the dealer says the flex plate is likely damaged, requiring an expensive repair at low mileage.
Forward collision warning light stayed on for weeks, and the sensor was diagnosed as needing replacement.
Drag link and tie rod links failed, causing severe highway shaking and loss of steering control without warning.
The dashboard display for the speedometer and RPMs went completely black.
Paint peeled along the roof line by the rear glass, exposing metal and risking rust.
The headlight module failed while driving at night, burning out both headlights and forcing the vehicle to be towed.
Power steering warning lights came on, strange noise occurred, and steering then failed because the rack and pinion broke.
The power lift-gate strut failed, bent inward, and shattered the rear glass.
The vehicle would not accelerate properly above 60 MPH, and the recall repair part was unavailable.
Automatic emergency braking failed to activate for vehicles merging from the passenger side after a software update.
Right rear coil spring came off after hitting an uneven road section, leaving the rear of the car sitting uneven.
The vehicle shut down in traffic and would not restart because the fuel pumps failed and a fuse in the power distribution center blew.
Transmission stuck in gear, skipped gears, and surged forward; dealer diagnosed a failed CDF cylinder and recommended replacement.
A steering arm dropped because a bolt was missing and another fell out during a low-speed turn.
Brake rotors and pads wore out repeatedly, with severe rotor damage and gouged metal at multiple mileage intervals until replaced.
Several warning lights came on while driving, indicating a powertrain failure.
Steering intermittently goes out when backing up or immediately after shifting to move forward.
Paint is peeling off the hood with no contact or impact, and the dealer would not cover the repair under warranty.
The driver’s side door check strap detached when the door was opened, and the door was diagnosed as needing replacement.
Recall repair for the air bag system was unavailable for an extended time.
Brakes failed to engage on a bumpy road twice, nearly causing an accident.
Panoramic sunroof shade sagged into the rearview area and blocked rear visibility, creating a dangerous blind spot while driving.
Condensation formed inside the tailgate light bar, consistent with the recalled rear light bar issue.
The driver side mirror vibrates while driving, making the reflected image blurry.
After a hybrid battery recall repair, the hybrid system warning appeared repeatedly and the vehicle shut off while driving on the highway.
Engine made knocking noise, entered limp mode, and lost power; dealer found the crankshaft had failed and needed replacement.
The horn stopped working and produced no sound when pressed.
Recall is incomplete and the remedy is not yet available.
Loose gas cap triggered ADAS warnings and disabled safety and convenience features until dealer cleared the error.
Rear suspension bolt was loose and nearly fell out, causing the rear wheel to tilt inward and the tire to wear unevenly.
Both high beams stopped working because the shutter doors inside the headlamp assemblies became unresponsive.
Recall repair was unavailable, and the vehicle was warned to have a disabled instrument cluster and unavailable safety features if the issue occurred while driving.
Engine maintenance message appeared and the coolant bypass valve needs repair due to a suspected defect.
A software update caused the vehicle to stop recognizing speed signs, making the driver-assistance system unreliable and unsafe.
Passenger airbag warning stayed on and a recall remedy has been delayed for years, leaving the airbag system unresolved and unsafe.
Side curtain airbags deployed unexpectedly without confirmed impact, causing loss of control, roadway departure, and injury.
Automatic emergency braking activated unexpectedly while driving, causing the vehicle to stop abruptly several times.
Defective brakes caused sudden brake loss, and a dashboard message appeared after the incident.
Rear struts broke while driving on the highway at low mileage, causing a suspension failure.
Rear back glass shattered while driving after the rear defroster was turned on in cold weather.
When braking, especially downhill, the vehicle lunges forward before the brakes catch, making the stop feel jerky and unsafe.
Transmission makes a high-pitched whining sound while accelerating.
Fuel system issue may require replacing the fuel assembly, and the owner reports the vehicle feels unsafe to drive.
